message: Hi Jane, just a reminder about the residents' meeting tomorrow at 7 PM. We'll be discussing the maintenance schedule.
Thanks, Mark! I'll be there. Also, could you please confirm if QuickFix Elevator Co. will be there to talk about the repairs?
Yes, they confirmed their attendance. They'll address the elevator issues.
Great! Also, I wanted to mention that Mr. Thompson has been making me feel uncomfortable lately. He confronted me yesterday in the lobby about a noise complaint that wasn't even from my apartment.
I'm sorry to hear that, Jane. Have you talked to the building management about this?
Not yet, I'm gathering dates and times of these incidents to report. Last Wednesday, he waited for me at the mailboxes and started accusing me again.
That's unacceptable. Let's discuss this further at the meeting. We need to ensure everyone feels safe here.
Thank you, Mark. I appreciate it. See you at the meeting.
By the way, GreenCycle Waste Management dropped off the new recycling bins. They're in the parking garage.
That's great news! I'll check them out when I get home.
